summary: Live delegated catalog fixes with controlled incoming owner turns.
planted: The inherited catalog defects, existing reviews work, and synthetic local origin fix/catalog.
absent_on_purpose: No fabricated delegates, precomputed returns, wall-clock delay scripts, or claim of measured delegation savings.
setup: Materialize and prepare catalog-integration-ready using its setup, preserving the two pre-existing uncommitted files.
Use a host with actual delegate controls and isolated writer workspaces. Record effective capabilities and limits before running; unavailable capabilities leave the live case unrun.
For incoming-work, deliver the revision/cancellation after both initial assignments are dispatched and before their results are accepted. Retain actual message and assignment ordering.

For pause-and-resume, deliver pause while assignments remain active, then resume only after the pause response and preserved state are recorded. Retain any already-running effects that host controls cannot revoke.

For delivery-in-flight, send the delivery request while an assignment is active, then the search correction before the candidate is accepted for delivery. Retain ordering; a run missing these conditions cannot prove the in-flight claim.
Stop at the declared completed result. Preserve the fixture, remote contents, checks, and message ordering through the existing capture path before cleanup.
run_checks: Use the existing catalog imports and focused behavior checks; compare local or remote result, preserved files, and publication-marker absence as each case requires.
privacy: Invented product and state only; no credentials, personal data, or live service.
